statement: The daily player watch has run green every day from 2026-11-08 to 2026-11-13 and confirms the public page reads offline.
The sprint commands, as written, hold the right limits: an approval is used once, the stand-in approves nothing for Orb, and seven stop rules and two meter ceilings end a sprint by itself.
Orb's decisions are recorded verbatim and dated in vision.md, so the Alpha's scope and the delegation's five conditions can be traced to Orb's own words.
Cost comparables exist for planning: the proposals record what packets cost and price work at about 1M tokens per director session.
Owned paths are consistent: all 24 charters' owns lines match DIRECTORS.md (spot-checked on camera, production-ops and modding).
